progettazione.descrizione: An exceptionally energetic, charismatic and captivating native Italian male storyteller, with the vocal energy of a passionate young science communicator and the confident resonance of a mature presenter. Fast-paced but perfectly articulate, highly expressive, exciting, magnetic and full of genuine curiosity. Strong vocal presence, lively pitch variations, punchy emphasis, quick natural transitions and compelling rhetorical questions. Every sentence sounds purposeful and fascinating. The opening words immediately grab attention. High-energy educational short-form video narration, with a natural conversational style. Never elderly-sounding, sleepy, slow, flat, weak, breathy, monotonous, overly formal or robotic. Avoid artificial hype and shouting. Authentic enthusiasm and irresistible storytelling.
